g.text: A product is registered before its rounding adder. The sum path has matching delay registers; clock-enable pauses preserve alignment.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #65717a

g.text: j = 1, 4 or 8. Data registers have CLK and EN; reset is applied to the shared valid/tag pipeline shown on R01.
